scope: Verified Table 31 and clauses 7.3.9,12.5.2 and12.8.2.2 against the locally supplied ISO 32000-2 sponsored EC3 text. Skipping a literal null array member is explicit reported reader policy; it is not dictionary-null conformance. Exact stored appearances and mutation ledgers are independently authored. Structural signature policy does not establish cryptographic integrity.

requirements.status: Reported literal-null member recovery shared by rendering, links and structural annotation-role traversal
requirements.rule: Annots contains annotation references. Repair may report and skip a literal null member, preserving every original surviving value/reference and its order. Strict rejects with the repair tag. Original-array work/result bounds still apply before filtering. A null or missing reference target is not a skippable literal member. This policy does not normalize the whole Annots field.

verification.rule: The source arrays and signed bytes remain unchanged. Recovery of an ambiguous signed annotation graph cannot establish an Allowed modification.
verification.implementation: Document-owned per-member gate reports pages.annotation-null. Rendering and links retain their original array gates/steps. Signature roles retain original-array allocation/walk, validate surviving referenced dictionaries and mark recovered membership ambiguous. Strict signed-source reopening and the existing final diagnostics-to-Inconclusive guard remain intact.
verification.expectations: Integer red/green stored appearances and a blue page prefix supply exact ordered RGB. Missing/indirect-null/scalar members and later malformed required appearances remain refusals. Authored DocMDP P3 updates with null ambiguity are Inconclusive; clean annotation/signing controls remain Allowed and clean content edits Disallowed.
verification.verdict: Explicit recovery and conservative structural policy, not general annotation validation or cryptographic verification
choices: Diagnostic owner is the page object with unknown byte position; unrelated content operator positions are not used.

repair_policies.behaviour: Only literal null members are skipped after explicit recovery permission. No original value is rewritten, and unresolved or indirect-null members remain required validation failures.
